stories.title: Man in custody after driving stolen taxi in wrong direction on A55
stories.summary: A man remains in custody after the vehicle he was driving was stopped while travelling in the wrong direction on the A55 yesterday evening. stories.title: Welsh drug testing service detects new class of synthetic opioid for the first time
stories.summary: A class of synthetic opioid that Wales’s drug testing service had never detected before has been found in samples submitted by people who believed they had bought heroin. stories.title: North Wales Police puts domestic abuse specialist in its 999 control room
stories.summary: A domestic abuse specialist has been placed inside the control room where North Wales Police answers 999 and 101 calls. The force announced the appointment on Monday 24 August. stories.title: Cheshire Constabulary investigating suspected arson at Chester’s ancient Minerva Shrine
stories.summary: Police are appealing for witnesses after a fire was deliberately set at the Minerva Shrine, the Roman carving in Edgar’s Field, Handbridge. Cheshire Constabulary said the fire is believed to have happened between Monday 17 and Tuesday 18 August. Officers from the force’s Rural Crime Team were told about it at around 2.20pm on Thursday
